pkgmetadata.longdescription: The initramfs of the Switch's live images (the installer): dracut's dmsquash-live boots a squashfs from the SD card's FAT partition with a tmpfs over it, plus the Switch's own dracut module. Made with dracut --no-kernel, before the kernel, which builds it in with USE=live (as Lakka does). It holds no kernel modules: that kernel has the drivers it needs built in.

use.flag: The silent boot splash in the initramfs (gensplash, from media-gfx/splashutils[dracut])
